map.计算需求价格弹性，评估价格变动对销量的影响: Compute demand price elasticity and assess how a price change affects volume
map.📖 查看「价格弹性计算器 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Price Elasticity Calculator User Guide"
map.需求价格弹性（Price Elasticity of Demand, PED）衡: Price elasticity of demand (PED) measures how sensitive demand is to a price change. High elasticity means price moves volume a lot; low elasticity means it moves volume little.
map.价格弹性 = (需求量变动%) ÷ (价格变动%): Price elasticity = (change in demand %) / (change in price %)
map.需求量变动% = (新销量 - 原销量) ÷ 原销量 × 100%: Change in demand % = (new volume - original volume) / original volume × 100%
map.价格变动% = (新价 - 原价) ÷ 原价 × 100%: Change in price % = (new price - original price) / original price × 100%
map.例如：价格从100降到90（-10%），销量从1000升到1200（+20%），: For example price falls from 100 to 90 (−10%) and volume rises from 1000 to 1200 (+20%), so elasticity = 20% / (−10%) = −2
map.：价格变动不影响销量: : price changes do not affect volume
map.：价格与销量变动比例相同: : price and volume change in the same proportion
map.：价格变动对销量影响大（奢侈品）: : price changes move volume a lot (luxuries)
map.：微小价格变动导致销量剧变: : a tiny price change causes a huge volume swing
map.富有弹性商品：降价可增加总收入（薄利多销）: Elastic goods: cutting price raises total revenue (thin margin, high volume)
map.缺乏弹性商品：提价可增加总收入（刚需品）: Inelastic goods: raising price raises total revenue (necessities)
map.单位弹性：价格变动不影响总收入: Unit elastic: price changes leave total revenue unchanged
map.：必需品弹性小，奢侈品弹性大: : necessities are inelastic and luxuries elastic
map.：占收入比例越高，弹性越大: : a bigger share of income means higher elasticity
map.涨价前量化销量会掉多少，判断总收入涨跌。: Before a price increase, quantify how far volume falls and whether total revenue rises or drops.
map.按 |E| 分完全无弹性/缺乏/单位/富有弹性。: Classify by |E| as perfectly inelastic / inelastic / unit / elastic.
map.对比促销前后收入变化选策略。: Compare revenue before and after a promotion to choose the strategy.
map.价格 100→110（+10%），销量 1000→850（−15%）→ E=−1: Price 100 to 110 (+10%) with volume 1000 to 850 (−15%) gives E = −15%/+10% = −1.5, so |E|>1 and demand is elastic; revenue falls from 100000 to 93500, so the increase earns less.
map.价格 +10%、销量仅 −3% → E=−0.3，原收入 100000、新收入: Price +10% with volume only −3% gives E = −0.3; revenue rises from 100000 to 113300, so necessities suit a price increase.
map.正常，价量反向；看绝对值。|E|<1 缺弹性可提价增收，|E|>1 富有弹性提价: Yes, price and volume move in opposite directions; look at the absolute value. |E|<1 is inelastic, so raising price raises revenue; |E|>1 is elastic, so raising price tends to lose revenue.
map.会。短期刚性、长期可替代则变弹；促销期与平时也不同，宜分场景测算。: It does. Demand is rigid in the short run but becomes elastic as substitutes appear over time; promotion periods differ from normal periods, so measure by scenario.
